+"""Test for the security scheme issue at top-level app"""
+from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends, APIRouter
+from fastapi.security import HTTPBearer
+import json
+
+# Create security scheme
+security_scheme = HTTPBearer()
+
+# Create the main app with security dependency at top level
+app = FastAPI()
+
+# Create a router
+router = APIRouter()
+
+@router.get("/items/")
+def read_items():
+    return {"items": []}
+
+# Include router in app
+app.include_router(router)
+
+# Add a top-level dependency with security
+@app.get("/users/", dependencies=[Depends(security_scheme)])
+def read_users():
+    return {"users": []}
+
+# Generate OpenAPI schema
+openapi_schema = app.openapi()
+
+# Print the schema to see if security schemes are included
+print("=" * 80)
+print("OpenAPI Schema:")
+print("=" * 80)
+print(json.dumps(openapi_schema, indent=2))
+
+# Check if security schemes are present
+if "components" in openapi_schema and "securitySchemes" in openapi_schema["components"]:
+    print("\n" + "=" * 80)
+    print("✓ Security schemes found in components:")
+    print(json.dumps(openapi_schema["components"]["securitySchemes"], indent=2))
+else:
+    print("\n" + "=" * 80)
+    print("✗ Security schemes NOT found in components!")
+    
+# Check if security is applied to the endpoint
+if "/users/" in openapi_schema["paths"]:
+    users_path = openapi_schema["paths"]["/users/"]
+    print("\n" + "=" * 80)
+    print("/users/ path details:")
+    print(json.dumps(users_path, indent=2))
